actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slowing Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 14, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. _Failure:_ 40 (9d8) Acid damage. _Success:_ Half damage.

actions.name: Slowing Breath
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. _Failure:_ The target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.
